states.description: No cached artifact and no resumable partial. A start attempted from here fails its preflight; it does not download implicitly.
A resumable .part transfer exists and no verified artifact does. The bytes are untrusted until size and SHA-256 both match.
The cached artifact matches the source record's size and SHA-256. This is the only artifact state a runtime start is allowed to proceed from.
The container exists and its process has not yet bound the published port. A liveness probe has nothing to connect to yet, so the startup budget rather than the liveness probe owns this window.

The socket accepts connections and the health endpoint answers 503 while the model loads. This is the state the two probes must disagree about: a liveness probe reading the health endpoint would restart a healthy process mid-load and never converge.
The health endpoint answers 200. This is the only state in which inference is possible and the only state that accepts work.
Readiness has gone false and accepted work is still finishing. The process is deliberately alive here, so liveness still passes; a liveness failure would kill the drain it was waiting on.
The process is gone and the container has been removed. The verified artifact is untouched, which is what makes the next start a cache hit.

transitions.trigger: an explicit acquire transfers part of the pinned file
an explicit acquire completes and the promoted bytes verify
a resumed acquire completes and the promoted bytes verify
an oversized or hash-invalid partial is discarded, or scoped cleanup is confirmed
scoped cleanup of the documented model cache is confirmed
the container is created with the verified artifact bind-mounted read-only
the runtime binds the published port and begins answering its health endpoint
the runtime finishes loading the model and answers 200
the startup budget is exhausted or the process exits during the load
a termination signal or an explicit stop begins the shutdown
in-flight work finishes inside the drain budget, or the budget is exhausted and the truncated drain is recorded
a restart creates a new container against the artifact the previous one left in place
scoped cleanup of the documented model cache is confirmed after the runtime has stopped

liveness.rationale: The runtime answers 503 on its health endpoint while the model loads. A liveness probe pointed at that endpoint restarts the process before it can finish loading. A TCP probe distinguishes a live process from a dead one and nothing else, which is the only question liveness is entitled to ask.

readiness.rationale: Readiness is false until an observation says otherwise. No state before runtime-ready may report ready, and a ready runtime that later answers 503 becomes not-ready again rather than latching.

states.description: Nothing cached. A start refuses; an explicit acquire is the only way forward and it transfers the full pinned byte count.
A resumable transfer exists. An explicit acquire requests the remaining range; the partial is never promoted before it verifies.
The pinned bytes are present. Verification and every start proceed with no network connection at all.

order.description: verify that the pinned image is local; never pull implicitly
establish the cache state of the pinned artifact
create the ownership-labelled container with the artifact bind-mounted read-only
poll liveness and readiness together until readiness reports 200 or the budget is exhausted
stop accepting new work and report readiness false
drain accepted work within the drain budget and record whether it finished
stop and remove only the ownership-labelled container

restart.description: A stop removes the container and nothing else. The verified artifact outlives every runtime state, so a restart is a cache hit and loads with no network connection. A restart against a missing artifact is a miss and refuses until an explicit acquire has run; it never downloads implicitly.

observations.description: The first start of a comparison. Nothing in this tool has read the artifact's bytes beforehand, so the host's own file cache is left in whatever state it was already in.
A second start of a freshly created container, run immediately after the artifact has been read end to end by the integrity verification between the two observations.
